scientific_integrity: All-size combinatorial proof and separate exhaustive finite-order corroboration; no computational search is treated as an infinite proof.
scientific_limitations: Restricted to finite ancestor-order forests and nonalgebraic one-types. Special cases for chains, stars, antichains and the general ideal/filter coding are prior background; an older relevant insertion-poset article was available only as an abstract. No independent priority determination.
title: A linear-time formula for one-types over rooted-forest parameters in the random poset
